data.text: Good to see everyone. My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 between us and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that each month if we stick to the limit. Let’s check our catches together afterward and adjust if needed. John, what do you think?
